title: IBELL Impact Drill ID13-80, 650W, Copper Armature, Chuck 13mm Keyless Auto, 2800 RPM, 2 mode selector, Forward/Reverse with variable speed

description: Powerful 650W motor with variable speed (0–2800 RPM) Delivers reliable performance for drilling in wood (25mm), steel (12mm), and concrete (13mm) with a 13mm automatic chuck for quick and easy bit changes. Dual mode operation – Drilling and Impact Hammer Easily switch between standard drilling and impact hammer mode for efficient work on wood, metal, and masonry surfaces. 2-speed mechanical gear control for torque and speed adjustment Gear 1 (-) provides low speed with high torque for heavy-duty applications; Gear 2 (+) offers high speed for lighter, faster drilling tasks. Forward/reverse rotation with lock-on switch Ideal for screwdriving and continuous drilling; improves control and comfort during extended use. Package Contents: 1 x iBELL ID13-80 Drill Machine, 3 x Masonry Drill Bits, 3 x Steel (HSS) Drill Bits, 3 x Wood Drill Bits, 5 x Screwdriver Heads, 1 x Screwdriver Head Adaptor, 1 x Depth Gauge, 1 x Auxiliary Handle. iBELL provides 6 months warranty limited to its armature and field, terms and condition as per the warranty card included with product
